## Why it belongs

**Why is resilience fundamental to the project's architecture?**

<!--
Which failure mode does it survive: internet shutdown, censorship, disaster,
infrastructure loss, off-grid operation, intermittent connectivity?

Using encryption or being "decentralized" is not, by itself, resilience.
-->

**What infrastructure does it actually require?**

<!--
List required servers, relays, bridges, gateways, bootstrap nodes, vendor
services, cellular/satellite subscriptions, or radio licenses. "None" is a
valid answer only if it is true.
-->

**Evidence that the project is active or mature and stable:**

<!--
Link to recent commits, releases, development activity, or evidence that
mature software remains usable.
-->

**Evidence of real adoption:**

<!--
Examples include real deployments, distro or F-Droid packaging, an active
community, or approximately 100 or more repository stars.

This list is not a launch platform for brand-new projects.
-->

**Security evidence:**

<!--
Name independent audits (auditor + year) if any exist. List known published
vulnerabilities or breaks. Do not claim anonymity, metadata resistance, or
fitness for high-risk users without a source.
-->

## Exclusion checks

**Does the project create, require, reward, trade, or otherwise depend on a cryptocurrency, token, or financial incentive layer?**

<!-- If yes, the project is out of scope. -->

**Is the project primarily an AI tool or agent framework?**

<!-- If yes, the project is out of scope. -->

**Is the project closed-source, a conventional VPN service, a centralized encrypted messenger, or military-only?**

<!-- If yes, the project is out of scope. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I am submitting only one project.
- [ ] The project is open source and has a working implementation.
- [ ] Resilience is fundamental to its architecture.
- [ ] I listed the infrastructure the project actually requires.
- [ ] I provided evidence of recent activity or mature stability.
- [ ] I provided evidence of real adoption.
- [ ] I reported security evidence honestly (audits, known vulnerabilities, or their absence).
- [ ] The project complies with the crypto/token, AI, closed-source, VPN, centralized-messenger, and military exclusions.
- [ ] The entry uses the required format and is placed alphabetically in the correct section.
- [ ] I updated `.github/data/repos.json` if the entry's main link is not a GitHub repository.
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
